purpose: Create an application-local CPython 3.12.10 runtime beneath C:\Projects\Active without invoking Windows installer maintenance mode, then vendor the unchanged exact 20-package Windows closure for synthetic-only Milestone 2 validation.

python.sha256_source: Official Sigstore bundle message digest; artifact bytes have not been downloaded.
python.license: Python Software Foundation License Version 2 and incorporated notices
python.official_behavior: The embeddable package is an almost fully isolated application-local distribution. It does not include pip, and Python documentation says ordinary pip dependency management is not supported; an application installer may provide third-party packages alongside it.

package_plan.resolver: Use the already-observed uv 0.10.7 executable only as external tooling.
package_plan.installation_mode: Download every exact lock-selected wheel into private Active-only custody, verify hashes and notices, extract or install the wheels into an application-local Lib/site-packages directory using external tooling, and explicitly configure python312._pth to admit only the application root, standard-library zip, Lib/site-packages, and site import required by the verified package layout.

prospective_custody.repository_distribution: No runtime, wheel, cache, synthetic checkpoint, or generated model output may be committed.

yes_would_authorize: Download and verify the exact official embeddable ZIP, its Sigstore bundle, and the unchanged exact lock-selected wheels into Active-only private custody
Extract the ZIP without registry, PATH, launcher, association, shortcut, administrator, or existing-Python mutation
Vendor the exact wheels into the application-local runtime and make only the minimal python312._pth change needed for the verified package layout
Capture licenses and execute import, dependency, CPU-only, deterministic-algorithm, subprocess, and synthetic compatibility preflights
yes_would_not_authorize: Any alternate artifact, dependency, version, source build, installer reuse, system mutation, credential, terms acceptance, spend, paid service, secret, OneDrive custody, or prior-repository mutation
Benchmark access or substantive training, checkpointing, inference, evaluation, tuning, or publication
Any model-family, protocol, cohort, label, split, metric, threshold, decision-rule, or claim change

known_risks: This is a materially different CPython artifact and packaging route from candidate 001.
The embeddable package is not a normal pip-managed environment; vendored packages and native DLL/data discovery must be proven on the exact host.
PyTorch and Rasterio include native libraries whose loading, subprocess behavior, and data-path discovery may fail in an embedded layout.
A new interpreter and binary wheels execute third-party native code if adopted.
mitigations: Exact official artifact, Sigstore digest, unchanged wheel lock, and fail-closed hashes
Application-local extraction with no Windows installer transaction or existing-Python mutation
No pip bootstrap inside the runtime and no source build
Fresh-process import, DLL, Rasterio data, PyTorch gradient, serialization, and exact-replay gates before use

decision_boundary: Because the interpreter artifact and package construction mechanism differ materially from the previously approved exact candidate, the prior yes does not authorize this successor.
